snippet.title: Darkest Dungeon: The Fire's Edge Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
#darkestdungeon #firesedge #redhookstudios

The Fire’s Edge, the first new DLC for Darkest Dungeon since 2020, is available now on PC, Mac, PlayStation, Xbox, with Nintendo Switch releasing on August 20!

The Duelist and Runaway make their debut in the original Darkest Dungeon. 

In addition to these two new heroes, this DLC also includes new trinkets, 3 districts and a unique burn mechanic for The Runaway. 

Buy now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4964110/Darkest_Dungeon_The_Fires_Edge/

Website: https://www.darkestdungeon.com
Discord: https://discord.gg/darkestdungeon
